name: Bloomlet · Gremlet #36
description:
A tulip bud that hasn't opened yet. It's waiting for exactly the right sunny day.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Bloomlet in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
